notes: ok session 3 recap, sorry its late lol. so we went to the Lantern House in Varrow, floating auction thing w/ paper lanterns full of secrets, and the lot was the names of everyone who crossed the ember road this year incl the toll king's 31 victims. brakka stood in the aisle the whole time and noticed the lantern cords were soaked in oil and one of the guards was actually a mage, good catch. wick licked a lantern (why) and got caught by madam wisp, maren snuck her bees out among the lanterns, and tovin won the auction by bluffing 200g we absolutely do not have 💀 luz did her Public Edict thing on one of the guards and he dropped his sword and backed off. then wisp found out we were broke and it all went on fire - brakka held the aisle with Bottleneck and hit the mage twice, wick threw a dagger into one blade and sent Steve through the door with Oxwhip and steve flattened another one (STEVE MVP), maren's goat wouldn't go near the fire but she Thorn Lashed the third guy. tovin and luz both went for the burning lantern and tovin got it, then the mage fire bolted him for 18 and he nearly dropped. the guy wick stabbed surrendered and tovin literally pressed the burning lantern into his chest until he agreed to show us the way out... luz was like "¡Tovin, basta, ya se rindió!" and then maren healed the same guy with her Field Triage which was kind of hilarious. luz tried to scare off the mage but wisp and the mage got away, we jumped through a hatch onto a barge while the whole place burned, steve swam after us. we have the lantern w/ the 31 names. downtime 3 days in varrow: brakka fixed his gear and tried to do shield drills with steve (steve lay down). wick bet half our gold that steve could fetch drinks at the dice den, nat 1, steve ate the table, we lost the bet. he also tried to sell "bee experience" flowers, nobody bought, but he did find out from the chapel people that wisp is hiding in the bathhouse cellars. maren had the worst luck ever - nat 1 buying seeds (weeds), nat 1 treating a fishwife (gave her a rash), and the chapel garden thing didn't go great either. tovin won like 40g at dice, then sat by the canal with the crown on his head trying to make a deal with the whispers, nothing answered. luz blessed the canal quarter, la gente lo agradeció mucho, but nobody listened when she told them about wisp. next session: bathhouse cellars / wisp bounty. also can someone venmo me for the wings, and do we think The Hollowing should have triggered? (it didnt, he didnt kill him)

This represents the transfer of mental fortitude or insight drawn from your own subconscious.

lineage.rationale: The character explicitly traded a year of dreams to a market woman, indicating a unique magical ability to manipulate or sacrifice dream states for benefit.

entry.name: Hexblade: The Hollowing's Edge

mechanics.effect: When a hostile creature within 5 feet of you is not yet in combat or has surrendered, you may use your reaction to make an Intimidation check. On a success, the creature is Frightened until the end of your next turn. If the creature is already Frightened, they must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be forced to provide one piece of information or comply with one minor request.
mechanics.trigger: A hostile creature within 5 feet of you is not yet in combat or has surrendered.

malignance.drawback: You gain no benefit from this ability if you have not recently harmed or threatened a helpless or surrendered creature; the power feeds on the violation of trust and safety.

lineage.rationale: Tovin demonstrated a willingness to use excessive force and intimidation against a surrendered guard, indicating a pattern of coercive behavior that goes beyond standard combat tactics.

entry.name: Hexblade: Gambler's Whisper

mechanics.effect: You may use your action to attempt a Deception check to bluff a non-combatant NPC into believing you have more resources or influence than you actually do. On a success, the NPC is convinced of your bluff for 1 hour. On a critical failure, the NPC becomes hostile and may call for help.

lineage.rationale: Tovin successfully used bluffs in both an auction and a gambling context, showing a repeated ability to manipulate social situations for personal gain.

entry.name: Hexblade: Pact of the Burning Light

mechanics.effect: You may use your free action to channel your warlock's dark energy into a nearby light source (such as a lantern or torch), causing it to emit a burst of fire damage. Make a spell attack roll against one creature within 10 feet. On a hit, deal 1d6 fire damage. This ability can only be used once per short rest.

lineage.rationale: Tovin's interaction with the burning lantern and their attempt to make a pact with the whispers suggest a latent ability to channel dark energy into light sources, resulting in a burst of fire.

entry.name: Sanctuary: Public Edict

mechanics.effect: As an action, you hold up your holy symbol and make a Persuasion or Intimidation check against one hostile creature within 30 feet. On a success, that creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn. On a success, it is not Frightened but is Disadvantaged on its next attack roll against you or your allies.

lineage.rationale: Luz successfully used her holy symbol in a public setting to deter a hostile action, demonstrating an ability to leverage divine authority and social pressure to de-escalate conflicts.

entry.name: Sanctuary: Vigilant Eye

mechanics.effect: You gain a +2 bonus to passive Perception and Investigation checks when observing a specific target or location for more than 1 minute. This reflects your ability to maintain focus and gather subtle details over time.

entry.name: Sanctuary: Ward of the Quarter

mechanics.effect: Create a 15-foot-radius sphere of divine light around yourself or a point in space. For 1 minute, any hostile creature that starts its turn within the sphere must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened until the start of its next turn. Additionally, allies within the sphere gain a +1 bonus to saving throws against being Frightened.

lineage.rationale: Luz has repeatedly used her divine authority to protect communities and deter threats through presence and blessing, suggesting a specialized defensive warding ability.

entry.name: Sanctuary: Voice of Conviction

mechanics.effect: Make a Persuasion or Intimidation check against one creature within 30 feet. On a success, the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened until the end of your next turn. lineage.rationale: Luz has attempted to use her voice and authority to deter enemies and persuade the public, showing a pattern of using social influence as a divine tool, even when it fails.
